name: isValidJSON
title: Whether the text is JSON this reader accepts

origin.description: TRUE when the same reader as fromJSON can parse the text or the file.

arguments.name: content
arguments.text: JSON text, or a path when the string names a file.

arguments.name: asText
arguments.text: Force the string to be read as text.

origin.details: A root scalar such as null is not accepted. An array with a trailing comma is accepted. An object with a trailing comma is not. A missing file is not.
origin.example: TRUE or FALSE, one per line, for an array, a trailing comma, an open brace, null, an unquoted key, an object trailing comma, a key with no value, a comment, and a file.
